categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies BufferedWriter in src/streams.h and adds stream unit tests in src/test/streams_tests.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents `BufferedWriter` from triggering `std::terminate` during exception unwinding when stream writes fail. Stream and serialization primitives require robust exception safety, and clearing pending bytes before underlying writes ensures I/O failures do not lead to unhandled destructor exceptions.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Modifies BlockManager::WriteBlock and BlockManager::WriteBlockUndo in src/node/blockstorage.cpp.
categories.rationale: Ensures disk write failures during block and undo storage trigger normal node error handling instead of terminating the process. Storage crash safety and clean error handling during disk exhaustion are important blockstorage concerns.
